map.：r²=1.3²+1.2²=3.13；cosθ2=(3.13−2)/(2×1×1: : r^2 = 1.3^2 + 1.2^2 = 3.13; cos theta2 = (3.13-2)/(2x1x1) = 0.565 -> theta2 about 55.6 degrees, solvable and inside the workspace.
map.：r>2m 则无解，目标不可达需重规划。: : If r > 2 m there is no solution; the target is unreachable and must be replanned.

map.平面内二连杆通常肘上/肘下两解，按约束选。: A planar two-link arm usually has two solutions, elbow-up and elbow-down; choose according to the constraints.
